User Story: As a user, I want to receive a notification when my account registration is successful so that I know my account has been created.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: System sends in-app notification immediately after successful registration. Notification appears in notification center.

User Story: As a user, I want to receive a notification when I log into my account so that I can confirm successful access to my account.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: System sends notification after successful login attempt.

User Story: As a user, I want to receive a notification when money is credited to my account so that I can track incoming funds.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: System sends notification after successful credit transaction.
Data Elements for Listing / Form: Transaction Type, Amount, Reference ID, Date

User Story: As a user, I want to receive a notification when money is debited from my account so that I can track my spending.
Acceptance Criteria / Expected Behaviour: System sends notification after successful debit transaction.
Data Elements for Listing / Form: Transaction Type, Amount, Reference ID, Date
